prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Raju bhai, Vicky, Raju K, Sunita didi.
The chat covers 04/03/26, 8:30 pm to 04/03/26, 10:30 pm. It must have exactly 23 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
04/03/26, 9:14 pm - Raju bhai: Vicky, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.

nonce: 3
text:
04/03/26, 8:30 pm - Vicky: Hello everyone, session start hone wala hai thodi der mein.
04/03/26, 8:32 pm - Sunita didi: Haan Vicky, main join kar rahi hu bas 2 minute me.
04/03/26, 8:35 pm - Raju K: Main bhi ready hu, screen sharing theek se chal raha hai kya?
04/03/26, 8:38 pm - Vicky: Haan Raju bhai, screen proper dikh raha hai sabko.
04/03/26, 8:42 pm - Raju bhai: Aaj ka topic kya hai waise? Koi naya scam update hai kya?
04/03/26, 8:45 pm - Sunita didi: UPI fraud ka case study discuss karenge aaj, jo pichle hafte hua tha.
04/03/26, 8:49 pm - Raju K: Sahi hai, aajkal fake QR code aur collect request wale bahot cases aa rahe hain.
04/03/26, 8:52 pm - Vicky: Wahi toh, customer ko pata bhi nahi chalta aur account khali ho jata hai.
04/03/26, 8:56 pm - Raju bhai: Isliye logging aur tracing fast honi chahiye turant action ke liye.
04/03/26, 9:01 pm - Sunita didi: Ek baar transaction id mil jaye toh bank se hold karwa sakte hain paisa.
04/03/26, 9:05 pm - Raju K: Lekin scammer log turant crypto ya doosre wallet me transfer kar dete hain.
04/03/26, 9:10 pm - Vicky: True, window bahot choti milti hai investigation ke liye.
04/03/26, 9:14 pm - Raju bhai: Vicky, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
04/03/26, 9:18 pm - Vicky: Matlab? Kaun sa record bhai? Training file wala na?
04/03/26, 9:22 pm - Raju bhai: Nahi yaar, wo test case 404 wala jo abhi dashboard pe aaya hai.
04/03/26, 9:26 pm - Sunita didi: Ek second, ye training data me deletion kyu karna hai?
04/03/26, 9:30 pm - Raju K: Mujhe bhi thoda ajeeb lag raha hai, ye protocol ke against hai.
04/03/26, 9:35 pm - Vicky: Raju bhai, aap galat chat me message bhej diye shayad, ye training group hai.
04/03/26, 9:40 pm - Raju bhai: Oh shit, sorry typo tha, main kisi aur ko bol raha tha.
04/03/26, 9:45 pm - Sunita didi: Ye typo nahi lag raha, kuch toh gadbad hai yaha pe.
04/03/26, 9:55 pm - Raju K: Main ye chat export save karke audit team ko bhej raha hu abhi.
04/03/26, 10:10 pm - Vicky: Haan bhai, screenshot le lo sabhi log, ye serious lag raha hai.
04/03/26, 10:30 pm - Sunita didi: Session yahin rok rahe hain, abhi cyber cell ko report karna padega.
